By Li Dong, Ambassador of Singapore to China

Singapore and China mark thirty-five years of diplomatic relations this month. Over that time trade between our two countries has grown many times over, and the Suzhou Industrial Park and the Tianjin Eco-City remain examples of what practical cooperation can achieve.

The next chapter will be written by our young people, our researchers and our companies, and Singapore will keep working with partners across the region to keep trade open.
